definition: Binary coverage of demonstrated acceptance criteria from the explicitly expanded 2.0 plan: original first-application criteria plus real use, retopology and optimization; not effort, visual-quality percentage, time remaining or Notion CLOSED status.
denominatorPolicy: The 31 IDs and their acceptance meanings are fixed for checklist version 1; each item is either demonstrated or open, with no partial or effort-weighted credit.
A new checkpoint lists the complete demonstrated ID set and cites evidence for changed decisions. Stronger counterevidence can reopen an item.
Preserve prior checkpoints and baselineEvidence/baselineNote. Criteria are not split, removed, or reworded to make progress rise.
A material scope change requires a new checklistVersion, an explicit mapping/reason, and preserved previous counts.
Optional broader character, UV, physics and engine profiles are outside this first-application denominator unless explicitly added by a recorded scope change.

Checklist version 2, explicitly authorized by the user on 2026-11-22, preserves all 31 original meanings and adds U1-U6; its fixed denominator is 37. Earlier 31-item checkpoints remain historical and are not recomputed.
evidenceConvention: baselineEvidence paths are repository-relative at baselineCommit; URLs are fetched plan sources. Checkpoint evidenceUpdates maps criterion IDs to {evidence: [repository-relative paths or URLs], note: declared scope and result}; sourceCommit identifies the tested code. Documentation of a requirement is not evidence of execution.
